## Verified implementation

- World const missing component pool now returns nullptr. Heterogeneous 3-component ForEach compile bug fixed; smallest candidate pool gives sorted snapshot. Two-component ForEach preserves first-pool candidate behavior (callbacks can add second component to a later original candidate).
- Query caches typed pools only per Execute/ForEach; missing types do not allocate pools; choose smallest pool before refreshing sorted IDs; reserve result. Re-fetch component pointers for each candidate after callbacks mutate storage. Clear/move during active traversal invalidates views; Clear between Execute calls supported.
- Real RunPlayerSystems, SyncPlayerPhysicsSystem, PopulateCollisionResults and Match::SyncEcsFromOop cache typed pools per invocation. TeamStateFillSystemDirect uses a read-only EntitiesSpan and creates after traversal. No cross-frame/global component pointers.
- VariableCache get_ref uses transparent std::less<> lookup; Animation GetVariableRef exposes non-owning read while retaining original owning GetVariable API. Actual animcollection/humanoidbase/humanoid reads use it. No animation ranking/formula change.
- GetVectorFromString replaces allocating token vector with three string_views, 128-byte null-terminated scratch per short token, original std::string/atof fallback for long tokens. Preserves comma skipping, atof behavior, signed-zero/NaN bits, embedded NUL behavior and coordinate defaults.
- New engine_animation_query_contract (native target registered CMake/sources) has 30079 checks, original tokenizing oracle, 10000 fixed generated inputs, stack boundary/long-string/float/ref-lifetime cases. Passed Release and full-core ASan/UBSan. ecs_query_contract_test has 8 meaningful Debug ASan/UBSan tests.
- Linux diagnostic engine_hotspot_profile is EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL, not linked into production. LD_PRELOAD malloc/calloc/realloc counters and 5 inclusive wrappers count only main benchmark thread in steady steps200..2199 (4200 total incl replay). Fixed4096-entry operator-new callsite table, top30 report, no dynamic bookkeeping, overflow0. Profile timings never used as headline performance.
